faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBRC Research Associate-I (Project) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the NBRC Research Associate-I (Project) recruitment is 16th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I (Project) post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Research Associate-I (Project) post is a Ph.D/MD/MS/MDS or an equivalent degree in science from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate-I (Project) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate-I (Project) position is 40 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories as per government norms, which can be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I (Project) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate-I (Project) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 58,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NBRC Research Associate-I (Project) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for the NBRC Research Associate-I (Project) recruitment is ₹200 for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. This fee needs to be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-I (Project) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-I (Project) post will be based on an interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job. The position of Research Associate-I (Project) is for a contract period, as indicated in the job type.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Brain Research Centre (NBRC) located?
faq.answer: The National Brain Research Centre (NBRC) is located in Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122052.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the National Brain Research Centre (NBRC). Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
